Short-basis inverse and T=B^(3/4) give the required power saving. BHB final comparison reused with explicit printed-slip interpretations.

rows.review_reason: Arithmetic Frobenius and abelian/cyclotomic compatibility determine the centering constant. W is fixed before N; no uniform growing-field estimate is inferred.
